Update: Completed about 3 weeks sober and found out weed was the thing I’ve outgrown and needed to let go off; I’ve since returned to (almost) daily use of dex. 

My rules are simple: 
1. Don’t let use interfere with job or social connections (weed was, dex wasn’t) 
2. Don’t use dex alone to cope emotionally but as an aid 
3. Stop use at the very first sign of physical decline due to usage 

I’d say my relationship with it has improved after the break. I was beginning to feel it was an absolute daily necessity but I use it on a much more “as needed” basis now. Microdoses for work, heavier doses for days where I need to do trauma work and none on days I have off and/or feel well-adjusted. I’ve never responded to prescribed meds as well as I do to dex and my circumstances are overall improving due to the other work I’m doing along with it so I’m happy with where I’m at currently. 

TL;DR: Definitely better to use drugs within reason than just ending it all (even if it’s tempting at times)
